FORM 10-K (excerpt) — this layout has no MD&A section, only risk factors.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

We operate in highly competitive markets and our results depend on rapid innovation. A failure to keep pace with technological change, adverse regulatory developments, concentration of revenue among a small number of customers, or disruption to our supply chain could each materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, and operating results. Cybersecurity incidents and the loss of key personnel represent additional risks that we actively seek to mitigate but cannot fully eliminate.

Item 1B. Unresolved Staff Comments

None.
